# Retired GitHub CI workflows

The definitions here were retired on 2026-09-30 and are preserved as a command
reference. Synthetic keys are replaced with `GENERATED_SYNTHETIC_CI_FIXTURE`.
GitHub Actions was re-enabled on 2026-10-01 after local Woodpecker CI was removed.

Active definitions live in `.github/workflows/`. See the
[deployment policy](../../docs/operations/deployment-policy.md) for the main PR
checks, automatic staging and separately authorized manual production.
